item.title: Week 10: Seahawks at Raiders
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 4:05 PM ET | Line: SEA -6.5 · O/U 40.5 | Model LV 50% vs. market 28% | On paper this one is close: Seattle's best edge is to keep everything in front (Seattle's defense ranks 1st in explosive play rate, 7.1% allowed), while Las Vegas's best counter is to finish drives (Las Vegas ranks 24th in red-zone TD rate, 58%). Under center, Sam Darnold ranks 25th of 31 in EPA per dropback; x-factor: Jaxon Smith-Njigba gets 35% of Seattle's targets and 48% of its air yards, and Las Vegas' pass defense ranks 32nd. The model favors Las Vegas at 50%, mostly on home field (1.7 pts) and offensive injuries (1.2 pts).
